patches.name: MergenV1 UI Enhancer
patches.description: Modern UI & interaction enhancer for stock TikTok and TikTok You (Android 13+): 120Hz spring animations with selectable profiles, swipe gestures, radial action menu, creator peek drawer, quick control sheet, camera-notch alerts, kinetic seekbar, 1:1 scrubbed Danmaku comments, and switchable Obsidian & Liquid Glass themes.
